source_name: 72_01_图片库＆设计资源_中文_女士_Chanel_Pre-Summer_2027_服装__072_media_cha_biarritz_ps27_071_text_description.md
text_description: Full-length couture-style evening gown in a pale grey, off-white, and black newspaper-print textile, worn sleeveless with broad shoulder straps and a low, softly squared neckline that opens at the upper chest. The bodice is close-cut through the torso and covered in fragmented newspaper columns and headline blocks, with a dramatic black feather-like or brushstroke motif radiating across the bust and a pale fabric rosette/appliqué placed at the center. The waist flows into a voluminous floor-length A-line ball skirt with structured fullness and a slightly architectural silhouette, printed all over with overlapping newspaper pages, text panels, and dark rectangular graphic blocks. A prominent asymmetric cascade of sculptural ruffles and folded panels runs down the front from the waist toward the hem, creating layered vertical movement over a central lighter underskirt panel; additional curved overskirt panels flare outward around the hips and sides. The hem pools lightly at the floor, mostly concealing the feet. Styling is minimal, with the focus on the printed gown and visible dark floral or feather-like earrings near the face; no bag or footwear is visible.
